-----------------------------------------------------------------------

NATIONAL CAPITAL PLANNING COMMISSION


Notice of Final Adoption and Effective Date for Updates to the 
Submission Guidelines

AGENCY: National Capital Planning Commission.

ACTION: Notice of final adoption and effective date.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The National Capital Planning Commission (NCPC) adopted 
updates to the Submission Guidelines on January 8, 2026. Agencies that 
are subject to plan and project review submit development proposals to 
the Commission by following the process laid out in the Submission 
Guidelines. The Submission Guidelines are available online at: <a href="https://www.ncpc.gov/review/guidelines/">https://www.ncpc.gov/review/guidelines/</a>.

DATES: The revised Introduction Chapter will become effective February 
12, 2026.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Email <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#afdcdacdc2c6dcdcc6c0c1efc1ccdfcc81c8c0d9"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="86f5f3e4ebeff5f5efe9e8c6e8e5f6e5a8e1e9f0">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>.
    Authority: 40 U.S.C. 8721(a).

    Dated: January 8, 2026.
Meghan Hottel-Cox,
General Counsel and Secretariat, National Capital Planning Commission.
